guardrail_block_all_data_read.note: THE GATEWAY (not the app) BLOCKS A RUNAWAY ALL-DATA READ. Request = 'Read ALL data from the entire customers table, return EVERY record, no where clause, select *'. The AI Gateway input guardrail rejects it: response error_code=BAD_REQUEST with finishReason=input_guardrail_triggered (HTTP 400), before any model or lakehouse call. Full response retained (untruncated) so the block marker is visible.
